pt.headline: Arrifana oferece ondas perfeitas e vento suave
pt.advice: Hoje Arrifana tem ondas de 3.1 m a 9 s, vento leve de 6 kt e água a 18.2 °C. Use fato 3/2 mm e fique atento ao Aviso à navegação costeira ANAV NR 2/22 em vigor na zona. Aproveite o swell antes que a praia encha.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue cedo para garantir seu pico antes da multidão.

en.headline: Arrifana serves clean waves with light wind
en.advice: This morning Arrifana offers 3.1 m waves at 9 s, a light 6‑kt wind and water at 18.2 °C. Wear a 3/2 mm wetsuit and note the coastal navigation warning ANAV NR 2/22 in effect. Grab the swell early before the beach gets crowded.
en.crowdTip: Get there early to claim the best line before the crowd builds.
en.moonTideLine: Waxing crescent · Spring tides · low tide 10:00

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Ondas boas, mas vento forte de 10 kt e avisos de interação com animais marinhos; pode ficar lotado.
spots.enReason: Decent waves, but a strong 10‑kt wind and marine‑animal interaction warnings; crowd may be high.

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Ondas medianas, vento quase forte e nota baixa; melhor escolher outro spot.
spots.enReason: Mediocre waves, near‑strong wind and low rating; better to pick another spot.

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Ondas consistentes e boa temperatura, porém vento de 9 kt pode atrapalhar; ainda vale a pena.
spots.enReason: Consistent waves and good water temperature, though a 9‑kt wind may be a factor; still worth surfing.

spots.name: Ribeira d'Ilhas
spots.ptReason: Ondas ótimas, vento leve, aviso de avistamento de animais; bom para todos os níveis.
spots.enReason: Great waves, light wind, marine‑animal sighting warning; suitable for all levels.

spots.name: Coxos
spots.ptReason: Ondas excelentes, vento leve, aviso de avistamento de animais; ideal para manobras.
spots.enReason: Excellent waves, light wind, marine‑animal sighting warning; ideal for maneuvers.

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Melhor nota, vento suave, água mais quente; aviso de salvamento marítimo, mas seguro.
spots.enReason: Highest rating, gentle wind, warmer water; maritime rescue warning present but conditions are safe.

spots.name: Carcavelos
spots.ptReason: Ondas boas, vento moderado e múltiplos avisos de interação; pode ficar cheio.
spots.enReason: Good waves, moderate wind and several interaction warnings; crowd may be high.
